input.note: procedural, no generated geometry; CC0 inputs only (Poly Haven scans, licence recorded); printed sheets from logged Leonardo calls (R8b)

mesh_acceptance.note: re-imported from final.glb: studio-wall-kit 7760 tris, 27 components, 0 floaters (a component touching neither another one nor the kit's anchor plane), 0 open edges

scale.note: studio-wall-kit 199.4 x 2.92 x 114.8 cm (x, y, z up) in the envelope 180-220, 1-5, 100-130 cm: three framed drawings (a 71 x 50 cm landscape over two 43 x 50 cm portraits) and a 96 x 72 cm cork pinboard, hung salon style on a wall

finishing.note: bevelled hard edges 188, hardened custom normals and smooth shading on every mesh, one UV set, 6 PNGs (wall_kit_atlas, wall_sheets each basecolor, normal, ORM), CC0 scans 2; evidence/context.jpg (EEVEE, dark studio rig) and evidence/target-compare.jpg (beside the concept's crop); every file under 10 MB

lynx_commit_note: stamped by the writer: the newest commit touching this folder when the manifest was written
budget_note: fidelity sprint FD brief (2026-10-25): each density kit one mesh and one atlas, at most 2 to 3 draw sections; 20000 tris for the kit
what: three thin black frames with white mats round printed drawings (a landscape over two portraits) and a cork pinboard in a dark wood frame with five pinned, curling sheets and amber push pins

generator.method: procedural Blender (scripts/art/studio-kit/build_kits.bpy) through the finish stack of scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy: per-part bevels (188 hard edges), hardened and weighted normals, unique UVs, one 2048 px atlas baked on the CPU from Poly Haven CC0 scans with curvature wear, grunge and AO

materials: studio-wall-kit/wall_kit_atlas: 6552 faces, baked basecolor + ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal) + tangent normal (OpenGL)
studio-wall-kit/wall_sheets: 1208 faces, baked basecolor + ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal) + tangent normal (OpenGL)
printed_sheets: wall_sheets: its own 2048 px basecolor composed from the Leonardo wall drawings (docs/concepts/vr-light-table/lookdev/wall-drawings: A, B, D and the three thirds of draw_sheets_atlas.jpg; calls logged in docs/concepts/vr-light-table/lookdev/log.jsonl, ruling R8b) and two procedural sheets (a ruled pencil note, a printed spec page); flat normal and ORM (roughness 0.86). UE: lit, not emissive
textures: textures/wall_kit_atlas_basecolor.png, textures/wall_kit_atlas_normal.png, textures/wall_kit_atlas_orm.png, textures/wall_sheets_basecolor.png, textures/wall_sheets_normal.png, textures/wall_sheets_orm.png; atlas 952.5 px/m on the visible surface (84 % of the surface hidden and shrunk), bake seconds {"base":1.44,"rough":1.38,"metal":0.62,"normal":2.05,"ao":8.58}; AO also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55 (the forward scene has no runtime AO). GLB embeds JPEG q92
placement: on the left wall facing the room, or the back wall left of the shelves (the concept's top-left wall of drawings): pivot = bottom centre of the arrangement on the wall's inside face (y = 0 is the wall plane, the kit stands out of it towards -Y); hang its bottom about 1.0 to 1.2 m above the floor. Blender -Y lands on UE -Y through Interchange, so on the back wall (+X) it takes yaw -90, on the left wall (-Y) yaw 180 (studio_level.py conventions); it replaces two of the four StudioPinnedDrawings instances there
axes: Blender Z up, facing -Y; glTF Y-up (Interchange lands Blender -Y on UE -Y)
licence: own procedural work (Blender is a GPL tool; its output is ours); bake inputs CC0: fabric_leather_02 (https://polyhaven.com/a/fabric_leather_02, CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/license)); fine_grained_wood (https://polyhaven.com/a/fine_grained_wood, CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/license)); printed sheets from our own logged Leonardo generations (ruling R8b) and procedural sheets
regenerate: node scripts/art/lib/polyhaven.mjs <work>/polyhaven 2k; node scripts/art/lib/polyhaven.mjs <work>/polyhaven 1k --models; blender -b -P scripts/art/studio-kit/build_kits.bpy -- <repo-root> <work> studio-wall-kit; blender -b -P scripts/art/studio-kit/render_kits.bpy -- <repo-root> studio-wall-kit; node scripts/art/studio-kit/kits_write_manifest.mjs <work> studio-wall-kit
